purpose: Fixes, BEFORE any pile number exists, how #1105's stage-3.5 decap claim is measured on the issue's own basis (a pile seeded from an intent emitted with --decaps-from) and what would make it a default. The corpus decap rows (tests/test_placement_ab.py, decap-after-ics/-within-limit/-after-queue) re-seed AS-PLACED boards under the auto intent, whose limit is ceil(max) of each board's own tethers, so their OFF seeds are already near-clean and the basis cannot see the failure #1105 reports.

base.stack_exact_confirm: not implemented at this commit; #1127 is decided before the decisive run, which records its state

input.stager: tests/stress/stage_unaided.py stage(): every non-mechanical part at the outline's bbox centre, rotation 0; the mechanical refs keep their pose and are written to mechanical.json beside the pile
input.where: <row workdir>/pile/<board>; the arms are written OUTSIDE pile/, because stage() arms the unaided provenance regime over its directory

intent.how: the CLI, so mechanical.json is compiled into fixed_poses as a run sees it

seed.engine: seeder.seed_from_intent with random.Random('0') and QUENCH_BASE's floors (clearance 0.2, board_edge_clearance 0.55, grid_step 0.1), no polish
seed.scope: place_seed's own rule without --force: seed_refs = stacked_suspect_refs when the pile is partially unplaced, else every unlocked part

unread_guards.why: the ladder arbitrates on the arbiter guards, so on those 'regress 0' holds by construction; these columns are ones the arbiter never reads, so a ladder that games its arbiter shows up here

eligibility.rule: decided from INPUTS before any seed: a board is a trial board iff its emitted pile intent arms decaps.max_distance_mm and its seeder_forecast scope is >= 1; a _pile_intent() refusal makes it ineligible
eligibility.ineligible_rows: run as pinned rows with expect 'neutral', so a regression on one still fails its pin; nothing is dropped after seeing an outcome
eligibility.record: whether decaps.max_pin_distance_mm is armed or withheld, per board

candidate.why_one: a best-of-N ladder inflates 'improve' under the null (7/8 per board for three coin-flip variants); after_queue + within_limit is the one family whose corpus rows improved boards with no guard rise

ladder.runs: two full seeds: OFF on a deepcopy of the board data from a saved RNG state, then the candidate from the same state; never a mid-seed fork
ladder.skip: if OFF leaves 0 decap_* errors, only OFF runs
ladder.keep_rule: keep the candidate iff its decap_* errors strictly fall and no arbiter guard rises and its intent_errors do not rise; else keep OFF
ladder.default_scope: seed_from_intent (whole-board or pile-only seeds, i.e. place_seed with or without --force); reseat_scope stays off

pilot.go_rule: the CANDIDATE (after-queue) improves -- signal falls, no arbiter guard rises, intent_errors do not rise -- on >= max(1, N-1) of the N eligible boards; otherwise STOP and report, and #1105 is not closed by this PR
pilot.note: the other two variants are diagnostics only and cannot change the candidate

pass_requires_all: (i) the pile-ladder rows pass gate() -- >= 3 eligible boards, improve on >= N-1, regress on none -- with the arbiter guards AND the unread guards at the tolerances above

(ii) tests/measure_1105_pile_polished.py: place_seed's CLI with its polish, OFF vs ladder, under --ignore-nets none and GND: decap_* errors and intent errors fall on >= N-1 eligible boards and rise on none

(iii) tests/test_placement_probe.py on >= 3 eligible piles, OFF vs ladder polished boards, --extra-nets = the rail net (seeder._decap_rail) of every cap stage 3.5 claimed in the kept arm: routed failed, open and unconnected counts rise on none
(iv) tests/measure_1105_ladder_cost.py: the ladder's seed+grade wall time is <= 3.0x the OFF seed+grade wall time on every board
decisive.then: a scratch flip of DECAP_CLAIM_AFTER_ICS_DEFAULT to 'ladder', the full A/B table, no seed row may turn regress and every DRIFT is read; the flip is committed with --write-baseline
decisive.corpus_rows: decap-ladder-<board> rows on the existing corpus basis are PINNED change detectors; that they cannot regress is true by construction and is said so, not claimed as evidence

stop_rule: any failed condition: STOP, report the numbers to the user, push nothing that says Closes #1105
